ValidationRule.description: If the Integration Stage is Project Kick-Off or higher then require Porject Kick Off Date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name != 'Payment Method', $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISNULL(Project_Kick_Off_Date__c), NOT( CASE(Integration_Stage__c, "Pre-Sales", 1, "Assessing Need", 1, "Awaiting Scheduling", 1, "Discovery Call Complete", 1, 0 ) = 1 ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must fill in the Project Kick Off Date.
